name: CLOSETED
source:
Every night before bed, you hear strange banging noises coming from your closet.
It’s probably just old pipes… right? Or maybe it’s stress. 

Maybe it’s time to finally open the door.

To face your fears, you invite a few acquaintances over for your first-ever sleepover. You’ll laugh. Eat snacks. Tell scary stories...
And later that night… choose who to face the closet with.

But what’s really inside?
And what happens once the door opens?
